summary: Tested 4 new features (Wave manager alert, restock request flow, admin order status filter, sold-out visual gating) plus regression on existing endpoints for KMB STORE. Backend pytest: 9/9 pass. Frontend Playwright: all UI flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductPage.jsx restock-size <select> has <option value=''> whose label uses inline JSX expression, causing React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-blocking but should be fixed by moving the conditional text out of the option child (e.g. compute label first and place as plain string): `<option value=''>{`Pointure${size ? ` (${size})` : ''}`}</option>`. Currently still functional.

Admin.jsx Restock tab counter (`Restock ({restock.length})`) is not decremented when using notifyRestock — only deleteRestock updates state. Minor UX inconsistency (counter is refreshed on next tab visit via refresh()).

server.py POST /api/restock does not validate that product_id exists; it silently stores product_name='' and brand='' if the product is missing. Consider returning 404 for unknown product_id to avoid orphan rows.

server.py DELETE /api/admin/restock/{req_id} does not return 404 when the id doesn't exist (always returns success:true). Acceptable idempotency but inconsistent with DELETE /api/products which returns 404.
test_credentials: Admin password: admin123 via X-Admin-Password header.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary restock_requests during tests; deleted from DB after run (mongosh deleteMany on restock_requests). Temporarily set one product stock to 0 for sold-out UI test and restored to original value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression pytest files: /app/backend/tests/test_restock_and_admin.py (new — 9 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_auth_orders_favorites.py. DB name: test_database. Product-page restock <option> triggers a benign React hydration warning. All 4 new features verified: (1) Wave order triggers TWO window.open — wa.me/{store} + pay.wave URL — confirmed. (2) POST /api/restock stores product_name/brand from products collection; admin GET requires X-Admin-Password, list newest-first; delete removes. (3) Admin order status chips filter list; verified counts change. (4) stock=0 product shows sold-out-badge + sold-out-msg on product page; add-to-cart, WhatsApp and Wave buttons all disabled; catalogue overlay + greyscale rendered.
